chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ṣāliḥ ibn Saʿīd, from Ismāʿīl ibn al-Faḍl al-Hāshimī, who said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a man who had intercourse with his wife while she was menstruating. He said: “He seeks forgiveness from Allah, the Exalted, and does not return to it.” I said: “Is there a disciplinary punishment upon him?” He said: “Yes, twenty-five lashes, a quarter of the punishment of the fornicator, while he is humbled, because he committed illicit intercourse.”

key_terms.حَدِّ الزَّانِي: the prescribed punishment of the fornicator, used here as a measure of comparison
key_terms.صَاغِرٌ: humbled or abased in the course of punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on intercourse with one’s wife during menstruation in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning a man who has intercourse with his wife during menstruation. It states that he must seek forgiveness, not repeat the act, and that a disciplinary punishment is imposed upon him, presenting the act as a grave violation.
